mfg1-electrical-l097.title: Pagkumpara ng packaging materials at resin production conditions
mfg1-electrical-l097.objective: Ihambing ang protective packaging sa resin method at production cost.

paragraphs.title: Material/logistics requirements
paragraphs.text: Paper, cardboard, wood, metal, glass, resin containers ayon sa product/transport/storage. Square o near-square timber ang kakuzai example; packaging design ang fixation strength. Protection/efficiency kaysa decoration; huwag alisin ang needed cushion/fixation dahil minimal materials.

paragraphs.title: Mass production at mold cost
paragraphs.text: Injection para sa maraming same-shape sa maikling oras, ngunit may precision-mold initial cost; hindi laging cheapest sa small lots. Iba ang screw supply, holding, cooling, shrinkage. Huwag rotation speed lamang ang shot amount; tingnan ang metering/injection mechanism/standard.

paragraphs.title: Resin/method
paragraphs.text: Blow molding nagpapalaki sa hangin, iba sa injection. Thermoset crosslinks kaya hindi same remelting. Biodegradation condition-dependent, hindi puwedeng iwan kahit saan. May impregnation, lamination, pressing FRP; hindi lahat high-temperature/high-pressure press lamang.

terms.meaning: Structural change na nag-uugnay sa polymer chains.

mfg1-electrical-l097.activity:
Gabay na 30 minuto: 10 pag-unawa sa teksto, 8 pag-aayos ng halimbawa, 9 pagsulat, 3 pagbalik-tanaw.
Sa 20 at 20000 products/year, ihiwalay ang initial mold cost at processing time bawat isa. Suriin kung reduced packaging ay tugma sa humidity, shock, fixation.
safety: Tiyakin ang qualification, training, duty scope, at aprubadong procedure sa equipment operation, measurement, machining, o setting change.
mfg1-electrical-l097.summary: Sa packaging/resin conditions, tingnan ang structure, gamit, applicability, bukod sa pangalan.
